name: Нарды
tagline: Приведите 15 шашек домой, бейте одиночные и выбросьте их первым.
description: Играйте в нарды (длинные европейские) бесплатно: одна партия или матч, кубик удвоения, честные кости с сервера онлайн. С ботами, вдвоём или онлайн.
about: Backgammon is one of the oldest board games in the world: a race of 15 checkers each around a board of 24 points, with dice deciding how far you go. You move toward your home board and then bear your checkers off; the first to bear them all off wins.

Each turn you roll two dice and move one checker by each number, or one checker by both; a double is played four times. You can land on any point that isn't held by two or more of your opponent's checkers. Landing on a single opposing checker hits it: it goes to the bar and has to come back in from the start. Once all your checkers are home, you start bearing off.

Win before your opponent has borne off any checker and it's a gammon, worth two; if they still have one on the bar or in your home board, it's a backgammon, worth three. Play a single game or a match to 3 or 5 points, with the doubling cube if you like (points only, never stakes). Online, the dice are rolled on our server, so nobody can know the next roll.
howToPlay: Choose a single game or a match, and whether to use the doubling cube. Then Play vs bots or Play on this device.
The opening roll is one die each; the higher plays both. After that the dice are rolled for you each turn.
Tap a point with one of your checkers, then a highlighted point to move there. A checker on the bar must come in first.
You must use both dice if you can, and the larger one if only one can be played. Doubles are played four times.
When all your checkers are in your home board, tap the tray on the right to bear them off.
With the cube on, you may double before rolling; your opponent takes (and owns the cube) or drops and loses the game.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a point with your checker, then where it goes. The tray on the right bears off.
Keyboard: Tab moves between the points you can play from and to; Enter picks and places.
Roll, Double, Take and Drop are buttons below the board.
tips: Make points, two or more checkers together: they're safe, and they block your opponent.
Avoid leaving single checkers where your opponent can hit them with a likely roll.
Building a row of points in front of an opposing checker, a prime, can trap it for many turns.
Keep count of the pips: when you're well ahead in the race, stop fighting and run home.

faq.question: Is Backgammon free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Are the dice fair?
faq.answer: Yes. Online they're rolled on our server, and the seed of the rolls is revealed at the end, matching the fingerprint shown at the start.

faq.question: What is a gammon?
faq.answer: Winning before your opponent has borne off a single checker: worth two points. If they also still have a checker on the bar or in your home board, it's a backgammon, worth three.

faq.question: How does the doubling cube work?
faq.answer: Before rolling, offer to double the value of the game. Your opponent takes and owns the cube, or drops and loses at the current value. It's for points only: kefche has no stakes.

faq.question: Why must I use both dice?
faq.answer: That's the rule: if both numbers can be played, you must play both; if only one can, play the larger one when possible.
